evolutions.name: Pyromancer
evolutions.description: Bind your spellcraft to living flame. Fire spells hit harder and Fire Shield burns brighter.

evolutions.name: Stormcaller
evolutions.description: Let thunder answer your footwork. Lightning magic favors speed, stun, and sudden angles.

evolutions.name: Arcanist
evolutions.description: Shape raw force with careful sigils. Force magic pushes farther and protects the caster.

evolutions.name: Cinder Savant
evolutions.description: Your fire clings to the air after impact, punishing clustered enemies.

evolutions.name: Tempest Savant
evolutions.description: Every shock leaves a path open. Control spells grant stronger tempo.

evolutions.name: Sigil Savant
evolutions.description: Your force sigils fracture on impact, catching more foes in the blast.

evolutions.name: Inferno Adept
evolutions.description: The line between torch and wildfire becomes a choice.

evolutions.name: Thunder Adept
evolutions.description: Your shockwaves hit with the force of a breaking stormfront.

evolutions.name: Aether Adept
evolutions.description: Force bolts travel farther before the pattern collapses.

evolutions.name: Phoenix Heart
evolutions.description: Flame keeps you standing when the forest should have swallowed you.

evolutions.name: Storm Avatar
evolutions.description: You move like lightning and leave thunder behind.

evolutions.name: Arch Sigilist
evolutions.description: Your warding geometry turns force into armor and impact.

ability_upgrades.name: Quickened Rituals

ability_upgrades.name: Warding Cantrip

ability_upgrades.name: Long-Tongue Flame

ability_upgrades.name: Fracture Sigil

ability_upgrades.name: Firebreak
ability_upgrades.description: Fire Shield burns attackers harder.

ability_upgrades.name: Storm Stride
ability_upgrades.description: Lightning magic sharpens your movement and initiative.

ability_upgrades.name: Widened Burst
ability_upgrades.description: Force Blast catches enemies one step farther from impact.

ability_upgrades.name: Greater Pyromancy
ability_upgrades.description: Every fire pattern carries more heat.

ability_upgrades.name: Greater Stormcraft
ability_upgrades.description: Your lightning patterns are faster and more reliable.

ability_upgrades.name: Greater Arcanum
ability_upgrades.description: Force and warding signs reinforce each other.

ability_upgrades.name: Wildfire Line
ability_upgrades.description: Flamethrower gains damage and reach.

ability_upgrades.name: Storm Ring

ability_upgrades.name: Aether Lance
ability_upgrades.description: Force Blast gains reach and impact.

ability_upgrades.name: Ashen Mastery
ability_upgrades.description: Fire damage and survival rise together.

ability_upgrades.name: Tempest Mastery
ability_upgrades.description: Speed becomes defense when thunder surrounds you.

ability_upgrades.name: Sigil Mastery
ability_upgrades.description: Your force magic lands with exacting pressure.

ability_upgrades.name: Crown of Flame

ability_upgrades.name: Crown of Storms

ability_upgrades.name: Crown of Sigils
ability_upgrades.description: Force patterns widen, deepen, and hold their shape.
